sections.title: باب 7 — متن (3)

paras.text: … first established peace through customs and traditions, moral codes, religious teachings and law. The establishment of peace has a very important role in society. Society tries to save itself from war and conflict. Through this, human life and property get protection. Through peace in society a safe and peaceful environment is created. When there is peace, the hidden causes of conflicts, differences and war, which exist in the form of economic competition, desire for power and foreign domination, can be suppressed and reduced. Peace finds ways for the peaceful solution of conflicts, i.e. the ways of reconciliation, negotiation and arbitration etc.
paras.urdu: پہلے رسم و رواج، اخلاقی ضوابط، مذہبی تعلیمات اور قانون کے ذریعے امن قائم کیا۔ قیامِ امن کا معاشرے میں بہت اہم کردار ہے۔ معاشرہ جنگ و جدل سے بچنے کیلئے کوشش کرتا ہے۔ اِس سے اِنسانی جان و مال کو تحفظ حاصل ہوتا ہے۔ معاشرے میں امن کے ذریعے ایک محفوظ اور پُرامن ماحول پیدا کیا جاتا ہے۔ جب امن ہو تو تنازعات، اِختلافات اور جنگ و جدل کے پوشیدہ اسباب جو کہ معاشی مقابلے، طاقت کی خواہش اور غیر ملکی غلبے کی شکل میں موجود ہوتے ہیں اُن کو دبایا اور کم کیا جا سکتا ہے۔ امن تنازعات کے پرامن حل کیلئے راستے تلاش کرتا ہے یعنی مصالحت، گفت و شنید اور ثالثی وغیرہ کے راستے۔
paras.pashto: … لومړی د دودونو، اخلاقي ضوابطو، دیني لارښوونو او قانون له لارې سوله ټینګه کړه. په ټولنه کې د سولې ټینګښت ډېر مهم رول لري. ټولنه هڅه کوي چې له جګړې او شخړې وژغورل شي. له دې انساني ځان او مال ته ساتنه ترلاسه کېږي. په ټولنه کې د سولې له لارې یو خوندي او سوله‌ییز چاپېریال پیدا کېږي. کله چې سوله وي، د شخړو، اختلافونو او جګړې پټ لاملونه چې د اقتصادي سیالۍ، د ځواک د غوښتنې او بهرني تسلط په بڼه شته وي، ځپل او کمول کېدای شي. سوله د شخړو د سوله‌ییز حل لپاره لارې لټوي، یعنې د پخلاینې، خبرو اترو او منځګړیتوب لارې.

paras.text: Peace is the cause of human welfare, prosperity and development. In a peaceful society the attention of people is on using their abilities instead of their defence and protection. People are engaged in their development activities in a confident manner. Children get education in a peaceful environment. People are busy in their own businesses. They have no worry about the protection of life, property and family. Religious, political, social and cultural life is at its peak. When there are no wars and conflicts, people abide by their own religious and political beliefs. There is no provocation, sectarianism and terrorism, and the ways of development remain open for people. In such societies tolerance, forbearance and acceptance prevail. In Islam too those people who spread disorder on God’s earth have been warned of a fearful end. From this the importance of peace is estimated. In peaceful societies justice has supremacy and there are no discriminations. In such a society human energy, reason and thought are not wasted on destructive thinking and actions. Human resources are spent on development activities instead of the gun. Where there is peace there are no violence and hatreds. The wheel of life moves on with zeal and there is no despair. Peace is peace, and at whatever price it is obtained it is little. Peace makes life like paradise.

… first established peace through customs and traditions, moral codes, religious teachings and law. The establishment of peace has a very important role in society. Society tries to save itself from war and conflict. Through this, human life and property get protection. Through peace in society a safe and peaceful environment is created. When there is peace, the hidden causes of conflicts, differences and war, which exist in the form of economic competition, desire for power and foreign domination, can be suppressed and reduced. Peace finds ways for the peaceful solution of conflicts, i.e. the ways of reconciliation, negotiation and arbitration etc.

Peace is the cause of human welfare, prosperity and development. In a peaceful society the attention of people is on using their abilities instead of their defence and protection. People are engaged in their development activities in a confident manner. Children get education in a peaceful environment. People are busy in their own businesses. They have no worry about the protection of life, property and family. Religious, political, social and cultural life is at its peak. When there are no wars and conflicts, people abide by their own religious and political beliefs. There is no provocation, sectarianism and terrorism, and the ways of development remain open for people. In such societies tolerance, forbearance and acceptance prevail. In Islam too those people who spread disorder on God’s earth have been warned of a fearful end. From this the importance of peace is estimated. In peaceful societies justice has supremacy and there are no discriminations. In such a society human energy, reason and thought are not wasted on destructive thinking and actions. Human resources are spent on development activities instead of the gun. Where there is peace there are no violence and hatreds. The wheel of life moves on with zeal and there is no despair. Peace is peace, and at whatever price it is obtained it is little. Peace makes life like paradise.

paras.text: … is that because of peace people use their thinking, energy and activities for development. They get protection from enemy attacks, mischief, disorder, fights and quarrels. They have opportunities to use thinking and energy for development-based activities. A peaceful society is not static, where because of peace there is no despair; rather everyone in a safe condition remains active for personal and national development. Wherever in the world we see development, in the background we should also see peace. In a peaceful society there are also no ethnic problems. Women too, because of peace, get opportunities to use their energies in a positive way. Everyone gets opportunities to work without discrimination. In a peaceful society the arts and sciences also progress. In such societies people are safe and they focus their attention on research, inventions and discoveries. The societies which are developed with reference to science and technology — there peace has played its full role. In a state of war how can Palestine and Afghanistan progress?

paras.text: A peaceful society is an educated society. Because of peace people pay attention to education, and in such societies the literacy rate is relatively higher. Because of peace ignorance ends. Change comes in traditional thinking, and all this becomes the cause of social change. This same social change keeps societies alive. Societies where there is peace are stable societies. They are long-lasting, sustainable and evergreen societies. Where there is peace there is prosperity. Everyone is calm and happy. In peaceful societies cultural activities too are at their peak. A peaceful society is a society based on high qualities. In it feelings of love, brotherhood, fraternity and cooperation grow. Here there are also no problems like unrest, terror and savagery, chaos, sectarianism and extremism; that is why such societies are called peaceful societies. In peaceful societies justice prevails. In such societies there is freedom of expression and everyone has rights.

The whole attention of the government is on establishing peace. On the contrary, our neighbouring country China, because of exemplary peace, is an emerging world power.

… is that because of peace people use their thinking, energy and activities for development. They get protection from enemy attacks, mischief, disorder, fights and quarrels. They have opportunities to use thinking and energy for development-based activities. A peaceful society is not static, where because of peace there is no despair; rather everyone in a safe condition remains active for personal and national development. Wherever in the world we see development, in the background we should also see peace. In a peaceful society there are also no ethnic problems. Women too, because of peace, get opportunities to use their energies in a positive way. Everyone gets opportunities to work without discrimination. In a peaceful society the arts and sciences also progress. In such societies people are safe and they focus their attention on research, inventions and discoveries. The societies which are developed with reference to science and technology — there peace has played its full role. In a state of war how can Palestine and Afghanistan progress?

A peaceful society is an educated society. Because of peace people pay attention to education, and in such societies the literacy rate is relatively higher. Because of peace ignorance ends. Change comes in traditional thinking, and all this becomes the cause of social change. This same social change keeps societies alive. Societies where there is peace are stable societies. They are long-lasting, sustainable and evergreen societies. Where there is peace there is prosperity. Everyone is calm and happy. In peaceful societies cultural activities too are at their peak. A peaceful society is a society based on high qualities. In it feelings of love, brotherhood, fraternity and cooperation grow. Here there are also no problems like unrest, terror and savagery, chaos, sectarianism and extremism; that is why such societies are called peaceful societies. In peaceful societies justice prevails. In such societies there is freedom of expression and everyone has rights.

Peace in society becomes the cause of many other good activities. Therefore it would not be wrong to say that the foundation of an excellent society is peace. If there is peace there is everything, otherwise nothing. In Pakistan, because of unrest, the process of development and change has stopped. The whole attention of the government is on establishing peace. On the contrary, our neighbouring country China, because of exemplary peace, is an emerging world power.
